# اُسْتُصْحِبَا (ustuṣḥibā) /us.tusˤ.ħi.baː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَصْحَبَ (istaṣḥaba)
# اِسْتَصْحِبَا (istaṣḥibā) /is.tasˤ.ħi.baː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَصْحَبَ (istaṣḥaba)
